<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-0101-23-54" status="unreviewed">dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa la <rs type="place">dbus</rs> su phebs | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">stod lungs rgya dmar</rs> gyi sar rta sga phog dbu tshad nyan pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3837">zhar chos pa dge bshes g.yor nyan</rs> la zhus | de dag gi skabs su bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang gang ba dang | don stengs pa dang | bya yul ba la sogs pa la smon 'jug gi sems bskyed zhus shing bstan pa'i rim pa rnams mnyan | 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya dmar</rs> la gsan pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">dge bshes phywa ba</rs> la sdig bsags pa lo brgyad du 'byang ma nyan gsung |</seg></TEI>
